data.body_html:
A dolphin watching brunch cruise in Marbella 2033 is the most memorable way to spend a morning on the Costa del Sol. Departing from Puerto Banús, you'll cruise the Mediterranean aboard a private motor yacht while scanning the sea for wild dolphins — all with drinks and snacks included. No crowds, no set menus: just your group, a skipper, and the open water.

What to expect on your dolphin watching brunch cruise

Your 2-hour charter begins at Puerto Banús. After a quick safety briefing, you'll head west toward the waters off Estepona or east toward Cabopino, depending on recent dolphin sightings. The skipper knows the hotspots and will adjust the route to maximise your chances. While you wait, enjoy unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks — all included in the price.

Which boat will you cruise on?

We use two boats for this experience: the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 guests) and the Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 guests). Both depart from Puerto Banús and come with a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, and safety equipment. Each has a shaded flybridge or cockpit, plus sun pads for lounging. The choice depends on your group size and availability.

Pricing and inclusions

The dolphin watching brunch cruise is priced at €749 for 2 hours (up to 9 guests on the Astondoa 40) or €749 for 2 hours (up to 11 guests on the Azimut 39). That includes:

  • Licensed skipper
  • Fuel
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%)

No hidden costs — just show up at Puerto Banús and step aboard.

Best time to see dolphins in Marbella

Dolphin sightings are most reliable from April to October, with peak months between May and September. During this period, the success rate is around 80-90%. Common dolphins, striped dolphins, and occasionally pilot whales are the species most frequently encountered. Morning departures (10:00–11:00) offer the calmest seas and highest activity levels.

What to bring

Bring swimwear, a towel, sunscreen (reef-safe preferred), sunglasses, and a camera. A light jacket is useful for the breeze. Life jackets are onboard for all ages. If you're prone to seasickness, take motion sickness medication 30 minutes before departure — the Mediterranean is usually calm, but it's better to be prepared.

How to book

Booking is simple: contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and any special requests. We'll confirm availability, boat assignment, and departure time. Payment is required upfront to secure the charter. Cancellations made 48+ hours before departure receive a full refund; within 48 hours, no refund applies.
